title: Filo evidence ledger entry
description: One piece of evidence behind one or more claims. Every Fact in a product or brand record points here. This is what makes every recommendation auditable: any sentence the stylist says about a product must resolve to entries in this ledger.

claim.description: The claim in plain words, e.g. 'Composition is 100% cotton'

field.description: Path of the Fact it supports, e.g. materials.composition

source_type.description: verified = independent evidence covering this exact claim and scope. brand_reported = the brand says it. customer_reported = buyers say it. inferred = derived by Filo (photo, AI tagger), not verified.

quote.description: The short sentence or data field the claim came from. Under 40 words.

confidence.description: Set by the rules in D_rules/ranking_rules.json, not by the language model

valid_until.description: For certificates and anything with an expiry

page_hash.description: Hash of the source content when read, to detect changes
